name: toolbox
description: Cool little tools for Claude Code, by jamubc.

plugins.name: redline
plugins.description: A tachometer for your Claude sessions: when the needle hits the redline, stop spawning and start finishing.

plugins.name: channel
plugins.description: Your chats in a pane beside Claude Code: read, reply, and get a toast when someone messages you. iMessage today, more chat apps to come.

plugins.name: instantnotes
plugins.description: Your InstantNotes in a pane beside Claude Code: search, read a note as Markdown, and capture a new one with /note.
